_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Find the technologies a website uses...

description: Get the technologies a company's website runs (CMS, frameworks, analytics, CDN, payments, hosting and more), each with its categories, version when shown, confidence and what showed it (a header, cookie, meta tag, script address, inline script, page element or HTML). We read only the home page, after its robots.txt allows us (a site that disallows us is not read), and match it against the open webappanalyzer fingerprint list (GPL-3.0, credited in the answer); no browser runs, so tools seen only in JavaScript globals or the rendered page are not found. Costs 1 credit. Every row has name (platform/collection/id), kind, its fields and source {platform, url, license, attribution, fetched_at, terms_url}; quote source.attribution when you show a row.

domain.description: The company's website, such as shopify.com (a URL also works).

name: data_company_technologies
title: Find the technologies a website uses
